remarks:
Welcome to this spacious 4-bedroom, 2-bath raised ranch in a desirable Southside Jamestown location near the edge of town. Set against a peaceful backdrop of woods, this property offers privacy, plenty of space, and wonderful potential to make it your own.
The heart of the home is the impressive great room, featuring a striking ceiling-height chimney with fireplace, beautiful pine walls and a vaulted ceiling, and an open design that flows into the kitchen with its vaulted ceiling and double doors out to a covered deck. The main bedroom has a door to the main bath with newly updated walk in shower and includes access to a private back deck, offering a quiet place to enjoy the wooded surroundings.
Step outside to the covered deck overlooking the inground pool, complete with a new privacy fence and new pool cover—an ideal setting for summer gatherings and entertaining. A spacious cement driveway leads to the two-car integral garage.
The lower level adds even more living space with the fourth bedroom, bath,  family room and sauna, providing room for recreation, relaxation, or guests. With its generous floor plan, unique architectural features, wooded setting, and fantastic outdoor amenities, this home offers a great opportunity for someone ready to bring their vision and make it their own.
